findings.title: Complete states assert outcome values that the screens never display
findings.description: Every completion banner promises concrete artifact data that no frame renders. visibleEvidence: export-import-replay_start shows card titles truncated to 'Protected field routin...' and 'Exportable custom-sc...' next to a wide 'Minimized' chip
export-transfer-verification_start and export-transfer-rollback_start both leave roughly 400px of empty dark background below the collapsed 'Local package details' row
export-protected-redaction_start clips the top text 'actor are preserved.' under the app bar and clips an 'Expand' / 'Generate export' button row at the bottom edge

Bottom nav is inconsistent: four tabs with 'Messages' clipped on the full-bundle/schema/checksum screens, only three tabs (Home/Documents/Messages, no Admin) on the transfer-verification and rollback screens

findings.title: All three export-redacted-bundle screenshots are the export-full-bundle screens
findings.description: B16_ext_export_migration_export-redacted-bundle_start/action/complete.png are byte-identical (sha256 6aacc2fc..., 1e8d1f12..., f1094ba2...) to the corresponding export-full-bundle files. Every one renders the heading or modal title 'Full export bundle', and the complete frame's banner body explicitly reads 'Full export bundle shows contents, redaction, checksum, file size, download progress, and'. The word 'redacted' never appears as a heading, state label, or outcome on any of the three frames. The redacted-bundle workflow therefore has no visual evidence whatsoever, and a user on these screens would correctly conclude they are in the full-bundle workflow.
findings.requiredFix: Navigate to and capture the actual redacted-bundle surface. Each frame must self-identify as the redacted bundle and show what distinguishes it from the full bundle: which fields were stripped, the redaction count, and the resulting reduced artifact size and checksum.

findings.title: export-import-replay action and complete screenshots are the import-preview screens
findings.description: B16_ext_export_migration_export-import-replay_action.png and _complete.png are byte-identical (sha256 3a1f8873..., dc822c23...) to the export-import-preview files of the same states. Both render 'Legacy import preview' as the title/heading, and the complete frame's banner reads 'Import replay ready' -- readiness, not a completed replay. No replay execution, no post-replay row outcomes, and no replay progress appear on either frame. Only the replay start frame contains replay-specific copy, and only inside a subordinate card ('then replay the import with retry and rollback available').
findings.requiredFix: Capture the distinct replay surface for the action and complete states: replay progress against checkpoint I-118 while running, and afterwards the rows applied vs skipped, the resolved duplicate decisions, and a completion timestamp. The preview workflow's complete banner should also say the preview was completed rather than announcing replay readiness.

findings.title: Every 'action' screenshot is a static explainer sheet with no controls and no in-progress state
findings.description: All eight action frames (full-bundle, redacted-bundle, transfer-verification, protected-redaction, transfer-rollback, import-preview, import-replay, schema-listing, checksum-evidence) are full-screen modals containing the workflow's numbered 'Export steps' list -- the same list already fully visible on the corresponding start frame -- followed by the identical boilerplate block 'Export workspace / Scope, redaction, checksum, destination, transfer status, rollback, and audit evidence are visible.' with 'Export scope' and 'Verification and recovery' sub-items. Not one contains a button, spinner, progress bar, percentage, or status chip in the visible viewport, and each ends on a duplicated row that restates step 1 ('Bundle contents', 'Destination', 'Rows preview', 'Schema list', 'Digest', 'Mismatch'). The modals also replace the 'Data Portability Community' app bar with a bare 'X', removing community context. The in-progress state of every workflow in this community is therefore undocumented.
findings.requiredFix: Capture the actual in-progress surface for each workflow after the primary action is invoked -- packaging progress, hash comparison in flight, redaction being applied, rollback restoring, scope being toggled -- each with a visible progress or status indicator and at least one control (cancel/abort). Retain the community app bar or an equivalent context label inside the modal, and remove the duplicated step-1 row from the 'Export workspace' block.

findings.title: Copy from other communities (HOA, youth sports) appears in the Data Portability Community
findings.description: The transfer-verification action and complete frames name the destination as 'Provider Cloud HOA' -- a homeowners association -- in a community with no HOA context. The protected-redaction action and complete frames describe the masked data as 'Protected youth profile, minor roster phone, care, vault, payment, and private notes' with policy copy reading 'Each masked field shows guardian or coach visibility policy and the persona allowed to reveal it.' Guardians, coaches, minors, and rosters are youth-sports concepts. The import-replay start frame carries the same leak in a card summary: 'Protected youth roster profile includes minor-da...'. The 'persona allowed to reveal it' phrasing is also inconsistent with this community's legacy flat schema, which has no persona system.
findings.requiredFix: Replace the borrowed fixture copy with this community's own domain terms: a data-portability destination provider name, protected field examples drawn from this community's schema (member contact, payment, audit fields), and a visibility-policy description that does not reference guardians, coaches, or personas.

findings.title: Complete states assert outcome values that the screens never display
findings.description: Every completion banner promises concrete artifact data that no frame renders. 'Export bundle generated' claims to show 'contents, redaction, checksum, file size, download progress' but no filename, size, checksum, or download button appears. 'Transfer verified' claims 'provider, hash match, receipt, timestamp' with no hash pair, provider ID, or timestamp on screen. 'Schema scope saved' claims 'include/exclude scope' with no table list or record count. 'Redaction applied' shows no masked-field count or before/after sample despite step 3 promising 'source label, exported safe value, and redaction count'. 'Import replay ready' claims 'duplicate decisions' with none recorded. Only the checksum workflow renders real values ('9A7F-PORT', 'file count 84', '18.4 MB'), and the rollback complete frame renders real outcome rows -- proving the pattern is achievable elsewhere.
findings.requiredFix: Render the actual result values on each completion screen -- artifact name, byte size, checksum, redaction count, matched hash pair, saved table scope, per-duplicate decisions -- following the pattern the checksum and rollback screens already establish, and offer the appropriate follow-on action (download, view receipt).

findings.title: Completion banners are truncated mid-sentence by the bottom tab bar on six screens
findings.description: The banner that carries each workflow's outcome is the element being cut off. 'Export bundle generated' ends at 'download progress, and'; 'Transfer verified' is cut immediately after its second line; 'Redaction applied' shows only its title plus a half-height sliver of body text with glyphs sliced through the middle; 'Import replay ready' ends at 'checkpoint, retry and rollback'; 'Schema scope saved' ends at 'include/exclude scope'; 'Checksum verified' ends at 'verification status, and integrity'. On the start frames the same defect hits the 'Package progress' card, which is reduced to a bare title on full-bundle, redacted-bundle, schema-listing, and checksum-evidence, hiding the start action entirely.
findings.requiredFix: Add bottom padding equal to the tab bar height to the scroll container so terminal banners and the 'Package progress' card render fully, and scroll captures so the state-carrying element is entirely within the viewport.

findings.title: Card titles truncate mid-word and minimized cards repeat one identical shell
findings.description: Card headings clip to 'Protected field routin...', 'Exportable custom-sc...', and 'Provider transfer roll...' while a 'Minimized' chip beside them consumes roughly a third of the row width. Each such card then renders the same fixed 2x2 grid -- 'Tap for expanded view' / 'Data package' / 'Expand' / 'Generate export' -- so the feed reads as one shell stamped repeatedly. Card summaries compound this: on export-protected-redaction_start both the 'Exportable custom-sc...' card and the 'Full export bundle' card carry the identical string 'Data package includes scope, protected fields, a...', and export-transfer-rollback_start reuses that same string for its 'Provider transfer roll...' card while export-transfer-verification_start gives that same card a completely different body ('Waiting for the export package to be prepared').
findings.requiredFix: Let card titles wrap to two lines or shrink the 'Minimized' chip so full titles render, and give each card a summary describing its own content rather than a shared boilerplate string.

findings.title: Transfer screens end in a large empty region, with an unattached 'Waiting' chip on the rollback start
findings.description: export-transfer-verification_start and export-transfer-rollback_start both terminate in a collapsed 'Local package details' disclosure row followed by roughly 400px of uniform empty dark background before the tab bar -- the lower fifth of the screen carries no content where transfer or rollback status belongs. On export-transfer-rollback_start a bare 'Waiting' chip is additionally rendered floating at the right edge in the vertical gap between the 'Package progress' card and the card below it, attached to no container and with no adjacent explanatory label, which reads as a layout escape rather than a designed status indicator.
findings.requiredFix: Fill the lower region with the transfer/rollback status panel (or expand 'Local package details' by default), and anchor the 'Waiting' chip inside the card whose state it describes with an accompanying label explaining what is being waited on.

findings.title: 'In-focus product surface' harness strip is visible, and the bottom tab bar is inconsistent across screens
findings.description: Four start frames render a dark strip reading 'In-focus product surface' with an 'Expand' affordance directly above the page heading -- capture-harness labelling, not product UI, occupying the position where product context belongs. Separately the bottom tab bar is inconsistent: export-full-bundle, export-redacted-bundle, export-schema-listing, export-checksum-evidence, export-protected-redaction and the import screens show four tabs (Home / Documents / Admin / Messages) with the 'Messages' label clipped at the right edge on several, while export-transfer-verification and export-transfer-rollback show only three tabs (Home / Documents / Messages) with no Admin tab at all. export-protected-redaction_start also clips a row of 'Expand' and 'Generate export' buttons horizontally at the bottom edge, and opens on the severed fragment 'actor are preserved.' cut by the app bar.
findings.requiredFix: Remove the 'In-focus product surface' harness strip from captured screens, make the tab set consistent across all workflows in this community, and size the tab bar so no label is clipped at the right edge.

findings.title: Multiple identical 'Generate export' buttons with no scope differentiation
findings.description: export-import-replay_start shows three visually identical 'Generate export' buttons in one viewport: one full-width button below the 'Package progress' card, and one inside each of the two minimized cards ('Protected field routin...' and 'Exportable custom-sc...'). export-protected-redaction_start and export-transfer-rollback_start repeat the pattern. Nothing labels which records each button would export, so the outcome of tapping any of them is unpredictable. Relatedly, export-transfer-rollback_complete leaves a 'Rollback' button enabled alongside a 'Rollback ready' chip on a screen whose body copy already states 'destination status is marked rolled back', with no indication whether pressing it repeats the rollback or is a no-op.
findings.requiredFix: Scope-label each export action (e.g. 'Generate full bundle', 'Generate this package') or collapse them to a single primary action, and either disable the post-completion 'Rollback' button with a reason or relabel the status chip to a completed state consistent with the body copy.
